1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __light-activated__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP is activated by light exposure during reading__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube, wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples, and wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is light-activated, such that the polymer material is selected to withstand temperatures of -20°C or lower without degradation of the light-activated MTP__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and is light-activated__.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; __an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes equipped with a light source for activating the light-activated MTP__; and __an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes and equipped with a light-activated MTP reader__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less, __wherein the light source and reader are maintained at temperatures compatible with the low temperature operation__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a light-activated MTP in plastic __by heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP, such that the light-activation properties of the MTP are preserved__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded light-activated MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; and reading the MTP __by directing light at the MTP to activate it and detecting the response__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated __and the frost coating does not substantially impede light activation of the MTP__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and light source, and wherein the vial receptacle, light source, and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is light-activated, such that the polymer material is selected to withstand temperatures of -20°C or lower without degradation of the light-activated MTP__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and is light-activated__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube, wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube __and is light-activated__.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube, wherein the MTP is light-activated__.
